data.raw_text:
Classic cherry-picking from @Bert_Control 😂

One side: Leni as mayor of tiny Naga City, asked a serious policy question about the Naga App at a formal international forum in Taiwan.

Other side: Sara as Vice President, asked a fun, light-hearted question about pandesal vs Spanish bread at a casual local bakery promo event for National Pandesal Day.

Different settings. Different vibes. Apples to oranges. This isn't proof of "level ng intelligence at leadership" — it's just dishonest editing.

Let's do the fair comparison the post deliberately avoids: Sara Duterte when she was Mayor of Davao City.

Scale matters:

- Davao City: ~1.8 million population, 2,443 km² land area — a massive regional hub.
- Naga City: ~210,000 population, only 84 km².

Sara governed a city 8-9x larger in population and nearly 30x larger in area. Way bigger challenges, way more executive responsibility.

Her actual mayoral record:

- Launched Byaheng DO30: 30 flagship projects covering education, health, poverty, infrastructure, waste management, agriculture, tourism, traffic, disaster risk reduction & peace & order.

- Peace 911 program bringing government services to far-flung areas.

- Bus modernization (High Priority Bus System) to fix traffic.

- Environmental wins: No Single-Use Plastics ordinance, watershed protection, bike lanes, heritage tree protection, Climate Change Committee.

- Strong COVID response and disaster management.

- Paid off nearly P1 billion inherited debt without taking new major loans — left Davao City completely DEBT-FREE by mid-2022, freeing up P200-300M annually for city services.

- Davao racked up dozens of awards for governance, transparency, competitiveness, business, tourism & health. Ranked 4th Most Competitive Highly Urbanized City (highest outside Metro Manila) in the Cities and Municipalities Competitiveness Index.

- Hit 93% approval rating in independent surveys as mayor.

Tangible results at scale — not one interview clip.

Bonus: Leni is a self-confessed bar flunker (failed on her first try). Sara passed the bar exam in one take.

Stop judging leadership by a bakery Q&A vs an international forum. Compare actual governance records. Sara as mayor delivered for a huge city. The record speaks louder than any pandesal joke. 🦅

#SaraDuterte #Davao #DebtFreeDavao
